paras: Radio earns something rare: undivided attention during the drive, the workout, and the workday. It pairs broad reach with the emotional pull of the human voice to build trust no banner ad can match. From local stations to national networks and streaming audio, Kosick Communications places your message where listeners are already tuned in, then turns that attention into awareness, recall, and sales. With more than 40 years of media buying experience, we know which stations, shows, and dayparts deliver your audience, and we negotiate the rates to reach them efficiently.

headings: How much does radio advertising cost?
How do you choose the right radio stations?
Can radio advertising work alongside digital campaigns?
Do you handle radio ad production and copywriting?
How do you measure radio adverting effectiveness?
What is the ideal campaign length for radio?
paras: Radio advertising costs depend on the market, station ratings, time slot, and campaign length. Local spots can start from a few hundred dollars per week, while drive-time slots on top-rated stations command premium rates. We negotiate the best rates through our station relationships and optimize your budget for maximum reach and frequency.

We analyze audience demographics, listening habits, station ratings (PPM/diary data), and geographic reach to match your target market. We also evaluate daypart performance, morning drive, afternoon drive, midday, and evening—to place your ads when your audience is most engaged.

Absolutely. Radio is one of the most effective channels for amplifying digital campaigns. Studies show that radio drives a significant lift in branded search and website traffic. We design integrated strategies that combine radio, streaming audio, and digital for maximum cross-channel impact.

Yes. Our creative team handles everything from scriptwriting and voice talent casting to full audio production. We craft compelling radio spots that capture attention, communicate your value proposition, and drive listener action, all aligned with your brand voice.
